1358.synopsis:
Set on a giant, almost finished bridge between Sadogashima and Niigata. Abandoned by the government, the bridge, and the giant man-made floating island at the center, has become a city of criminals and societal drop-outs. 
Set in the same world as Durarara, but 15-20 years later. There is almost no overlap between Etsusa Bridge and the other novels.

4430.synopsis:
Obtaining the power of flight, invisibility, and teleportation―― Kirishima Ren was sent to another world.
It was a world of swords and magic. I was able to survive in the seedy underworld using my supernatural powers.
One day, while stalking…… er I mean, protecting stealthily from the shadows, I ended up raping the princess. While treating my princess as a s*x toy, I became involved with cute girls one after the other.
From manipulating a tomboyish witch, to taking care of a troublesome cat girl while entrapping two elf sisters. Little by little, I had reached my hand to the center of the country.
Incidentally, I was able to take hold of the King’s weakness and tried to do anything as I pleased. And now, I’m going to invade the love hotel… I mean, the castle.

5198.synopsis:
The witch was who you would call a witch.
Wrapped up in a black robe and stirring the contents of her cauldron, cackling “Eeeheehehee!” all the while – she belonged to that category of so-called witches.
A face that was deeply carved with wrinkles. An aged body that was appraised as the hag amongst hags, more hags, and even more hags.
To the side of that witch, the third son of the local feudal lord came along without bringing any companions.
Let’s see, the splendid young lord’s reason for his “esteemed” consultation is…

6990.synopsis:
In a world where magic is long but a thing of the distant past, where humans have the potential of harnessing a dormant power within them, called Battle Force…
A man from modern-day Earth finds himself suddenly waking up in the body of Norton Lorist, a youth of noble descent that had been exiled from his homeland in the North by his family to Morante City, the capital of the Forde Trade Union on the pretext of pursuing his studies.
Little did he know what would await him when he receives a summons from his family years later to return to the Northlands and inherit the position of the family head…
This is the tale of his life before the summons…
This is the tale of his journey northward and the allies he gathers along the way…
This is the tale of his rebuilding his family’s dominion and keeping it safe from other power-hungry nobles…
This is the tales of the Reincarnated Lord.

8014.synopsis:

 “Model analysis”. 
However, when he was creating a character model in his mind by analyzing the opposing side’s ability, a crazy idea echoed in his mind. What would happen if he creates a model of the entire world? This would imply that he… would be like a God, controlling the world!

9038.synopsis:
5th Book of the A Mistaken Marriage Match series. 
What would happen if you put together a thick-skinned bailiff who concealed his true self deeply with the cold and sharp beloved daughter of the Prime Minister’s manor who was currently ‘running away’ from home?
Originally, one was merely going along with an arranged bet and picked a country which one was a bit interested in – Liao Yue. One had planned to go on a scenic tour while looking for a rare treasure on the side for the “One Year Agreement”.
Unexpectedly, one had just arrived at the border of Liao Yue when one encountered a mu*der case and in passing, also came across an interesting person who looked roguish, but was actually an incisive bailiff.
What surprised her even more was that this bailiff’s history was so secretive and bizarre, and unexpectedly still had a connection to her pliable sword “Cang Feng” which had accompanied her for so many years.
It seemed that following her steps to the center of the capital of Liao Yue, those “vicious beasts” who originally hid beneath the layer after layer of thick fog began to mobilize their fierce pawns toward her…

Having the fortune of peach blossoms! Unfavorable to luck this year?

Waiting for glory, who was it that will forever be with her: Holding hands, together through the wind and frost, accompanying you no matter what; Deep kisses, along with deep affection, being together for a thousand reincarnations!
Only to know, the most intense inner conflict, in the end, was the purest.

He, with a heavy temperament, having seen the celestial patterns, but allowing it to become a song: “Luan’er remember that when we met at the beginning of the spring night, you were dressed in a man’s robes, full of a heroic aura. 19534.synopsis: A continuation from where High School DxD Volume 25 left off.

19790.synopsis:
Xie Huaimin who had been jilted, unexpectedly came to the unfamiliar nation of Dong Qi and became Xie Zhaohua, the idiotic Fourth Miss of the Grand Tutor Xie’s family in Dong Qi. Ready to be flexible to her newfound circumstances, she strived to let herself adapt to life in a feudalistic society but her eccentric Second Brother, Xie Zhaoying, implicated her in a complicated web of intricacies. The Zhao family’s party which dominates the court administration, the refined and mysterious teacher Song Zijing from Xi Qi and also Prince Yan, Xiao Xuan, who is remotely far away, form a world full of perils and excitement. Miss Xie who is imbued with courage and insensitive yet pure, followed along with Xiao Xuan without second thoughts, throwing herself into the venture of revolution and love.
T/n: The title of the novel originated from a Chinese poem by Yan Jidao.

21070.synopsis:
The enchanting and beautiful big brother’s mouth lifted up into a demonic smile, spitting out cruel and sorrowful words. “Take it out, don’t leave an intact corpse!”

Their eyes were purple and enchanting. They were this world’s devils, banished by the people.
When they gained strength, they retaliated by destroying the heavens and exterminating the earth.
She was a girl who mistakenly entered another world. She’s their salvation and is the only one that must be obtained at all costs.
Overbearingly possessive and absolutely unrestrained indulgent pampering as long as she stayed by their side.
A gentle as jade man, a faint and dedicated guard.

24398.synopsis:
For the once dead Hua Yu Man, she has to do three things this lifetime: kill those who harmed her, kill the man who said he loved her, and protect a place called “home.”

With the Full-time Lottery System, one can draw the lottery for prizes! Specifically, it endows skills related to a profession to the one drawing. As one completes tasks and draw lotteries, one will reach the apex and become a master of that profession.

28750.synopsis: Waking up from a hangover, Wang Hao finds himself reborn in an alternate world. To his delight, he realizes that he has a system to help him in this new world. Instead of serving justice and winning the respect of other people, Wang Hao has to do all kinds of bad things in order to make use of the system. So, Wang Hao embarks on the journey to being cursed for good…

29262.synopsis:
Nie Jia lived his life with kindness and respect, yet all his actions were paid back with the cold grey walls of prison. Inside the bars, he vowed that if he ever had another life, he would be a complete villain! Beast! Scoundrel!

Jian Rui Xi, who was on an island vacation with little fresh meat (aka boytoy),  transmigrated into a book and became a comparison character of a classic rich family spoiling wife novel.

33102.synopsis:
Su Yu had been an only child. Her paternal grandfather raised her as if she was a boy that would succeed the family. However, when she was ten years old, her mother gave birth to a pair of fraternal twins. Now that the Su’s had a son to inherit, she had had to step aside. For Su Yu, this was a wonderful thing. She was happy to be able to live a good life without working.
Who knew that her father would learn from others and want to marry off his daughter into an alliance marriage? If her chosen fiance was good in all aspects, she could have tolerated her father’s arrangement. However, her chosen fiance was a person with IQ problems.
At that moment, Su Yu suddenly understood the old saying. It was every person for themselves, and the devil took the hindmost. After seizing control of the family assets from her weak and incompetent father, she made up her mind to be the head of the household for the rest of her life. However, it seemed that the heavens wouldn’t let her live a free and easy life. After a good night’s sleep, she woke up and was back in 1959. She had become another person with the same name.
The original owner was someone that worked like a dog for her family, but Su Yu wouldn’t do such a s*upid thing even if someone threatened her with death. Even if she were to work extremely hard for her family, she would require her family to work extremely hard for her too.

35406.synopsis:
Sleeping with him was a very impulsive decision.
Yesterday, Damia’s first love that usually filled her with anxious joy, broke her heart with a cruel rejection:
“Find another man.”
Her manipulative step-brother smiled at her.
“Didn’t I tell you? You will eventually come to me.”
Damia was fed up with all these games.
So she seduced and slept with the man who had just arrived in the north.
The beautiful eyes belonging to the woman subject to terrible rumors held no lust, instead Akkard found her to be rather clumsy and pure.
“Your crying face is pretty. Cry a little more.”
He grabbed Damia’s ankles that tried to flee, overworked from his persistent ardor, but that only made him covet her even more.
Damia, lying beneath the ferocious beast, literally cried herself hoarse.
The man kissed all of her tears, and painstakingly l**ked her eyelids.
And soon he laughed greedily.
“Try keep crying under me from now on.”
The man’s lips whispered until the legs broke apart.

35918.synopsis:
The second prince from the Yan State, Yu Yan, has pretended to be an alpha for many years, but after having an unexpected heat, he slept with his personal shadow guard.
And what is more unfortunate is, due to Yu Yan using suppressant medicines long-term, damaging his constitution, his heat is no longer controllable.
He can only ask his shadow guard to assist him regularly to deal with his heats, but good thing is that his shadow guard is very obedient and loyal, willing to do whatever he says, and doesn’t mind helping him.
But the situation slowly becomes strange –
Yu Yan, with a hoarse voice, cursing: Get out!
The shadow guard restrains him in his embrace, with an innocent look in his eyes: Where does master want me to pull out from?
Yu Yan: …QAQ
And even later, the new Yan State emperor ascends the throne, the young monarch sits upright on his dragon throne, under the gaze of of many: vomits –

36430.synopsis:
She possessed the woman who was married to the devil.

37454.synopsis:
A replica of Marquis Kieran Vale, the son of the Marchioness of Vale, who she deemed a failure. That was all she was. No, she was now referred to as “he.” At least until she met Claude Del Ihar.
*
Claude stared silently at the sleeping Canillian. His gold lashes created a soft shadow on a white face. No matter how much he despised outdoor activities, he was still too white and thin. No trace of puberty was evident on him, and above all, his scent was different from the usual smell of men’s sweat. Was it the scent of lavender blooming all over the Marquis’s work or the scent of poppies blooming in the river?
Canillian’s soft cheeks brushed the tip of his nose, and instinctively, he bowed his head as if to savor the scent more. Canillian’s shallow breaths tickled his temple. His pulse began to race. Claude leaned further without thought. He wanted to enjoy it more. No, he really wanted to taste it. He was curious about what he’d taste if his tongue were to graze his skin. 
I must be crazy… or going crazy, he thought. Claude sighed. He stared at Canillian once more, and heat started to invade his entire body, captivated by Canillian’s lips which looked like it was glazed with honey. 
Perhaps it was the hot atmosphere that caused such reaction from him, he reasoned out. If not, by no means… he wouldn’t have thought of wanting to kiss this guy.

associated_names: Isekai ni Kyuuseishu to shite Yobaremashita ga, Around 30 ni wa Muri na no de, hissori Book Café Hajimemashita.

When you’re going about your day as usual and suddenly find out that the guy who had a crush on you that you ignored has become a ghost lingering behind you late at night…
When you suddenly find out that your boyfriend is a monster in human skin…
When you hear about a netizen committing su*cide because of an online relationship breakup and suddenly find out that it was you who dumped him…
When you’re stranded on a deserted island and suddenly find out that your dead childhood friend has become a bandage-wearing weirdo hunting down intruders on the island…
When you suddenly find out that your lover is not human.
—It loves you to the bone, and you can’t escape it.
In the end, their karma is inextricably tangled together.
This is a story that turns an eerie urban legend into a romantic drama.

50766.synopsis:
Tao Xiaodong had a blind brother. Tang Suoyan, gentle and calm, was his brother’s favourite doctor, and Tao Xiaodong couldn’t help but like him for that.
Oftentimes, people lose sight of that which was easily gained.
Over the years, Tong Ning was so coddled by Tang Suoyan that he failed to appreciate how fetching this rare specimen was—dumping him without pause, and picking him up again when he had a change of heart.
Except, this time, he was a step too late. Tao Xiaodong had long made his move.
Tao Xiaodong looked at Tong Ning, telling him with a smile, “It doesn’t matter who Tang Suoyan used to be with. He’s mine now. As long as I don’t let go, you’ll never be able to take away what I hold onto.”

52558.synopsis:
Others were chased by fierce ghosts for three days and nights in this horror world. However, Su Qingxing, who was hiding in the group pretending to be a rookie, quietly waved to the ghost child over there and asked, “Xiao Ming, where is your mother?”

*扮猪吃老虎: bàn zhū chī lǎo hǔ: A Chinese idiom that means acting dumb/pretending to be weak to lower somebody’s security so that attacking (surprising) them is easier.

55118.synopsis:
I, Bouchi Hiro, was ostracized by the entire school because I stood up against the student who held an absolute power in the school. But no matter what kind of bullying I received every day, I never yielded. Today as well, I was getting beaten up behind the school building. But at that moment, I heard the students screaming―That was the moment when the world was transformed.
On the school grounds, the students were being attacked and killed one after another by monsters that seemed to have come out from an RPG. She’s just an onlooker who stumbled into this world by accident.  
As an onlooker, her life revolves around watching the drama unfold. She doesn’t want other people’s excitement, nor does she meddle in others’ affairs.  
Her goal? Quietly amass a fortune. She’s set a modest goal of earning a few hundred million, attending college, buying a house… and another house… and then more houses.  
She’s determined to live the life of a self-sufficient, laid-back “salted fish” (slang for someone who takes it easy). If she can spend her days lounging on a sofa with her feet up, she’ll consider it a life well-lived.
associated_names: 穿書七十年代吃瓜群衆的自我修養

104014.synopsis:
My childhood friend who lost her memory in an accident only remembers me. We decided to stay at my house until she regains her memory.
“Why are you casually climbing into my bed?”
“Isn’t this my place?”
“…Isn’t that ever the case?”
The distance between us has become too close.

104526.synopsis:
“Become ‘my’ mom!”
The protagonist, Sanada Isaki, intends to summon the school’s most beautiful girl, Imiya Miori, to ask her for an unreasonable favor. However, due to overwhelming nervousness, he ended up making a ridiculous mistake in his words, and after being bewildered, Miori ended up running away.
The unreasonable request that Isaki wanted to ask was a heartfelt plea for Miori, “I want you to play the role of the mother of my 5-year-old sister, Shuri.”
Upon learning the circumstances, Miori sees “her past self” in Shuri and she takes on the role of a mother despite her hesitation. As she interacts with Isaki, she touches upon the troubles hidden in his heart──
“Don’t sacrifice yourself. Let’s make memories together.”
“Spending time with Isaki-kun and Shuri-chan, playing together… then it will surely become a memory just for us.”
Through the suddenly started pseudo-family (playhouse) life between the kindergarteners and high school students, Isaki and Miori gradually become attracted to each other.
Not only love but also family love is depicted in this heartwarming romantic comedy with a classmate who takes on the role of mother, and it begins here!
associated_names: 学校一の美少女がお母さんになりました。

107598.synopsis:
Resource Deposits: Unmeasurable
Resource Rarity: SSS
Map Size: Unmeasurable
I had just received my very own infinite resource map.
associated_names: SSS+ Grade Hunter Who Does Farming

108110.synopsis:
Even back in Korea, I had terrible luck with bosses.
My incompetent mentor, Assistant Manager Lee.  
The idea-stealing Manager Park.  
And the ghost of every company dinner, Director Choi.
Every one of them was, without a doubt, the worst kind of superior.
But after being possessed into a novel—
The boss I ended up serving made those guys look downright adorable.
My emperor, that bastard—Friedrich von Reinhardt.
“You think I can’t bring you down just because you’re the emperor?”
If someone like you is destined to be the protagonist of this world, then fine—
I’ll change the protagonist.

109134.synopsis:
Cove’s Raven, the assassin Gio.
After presenting as an omega, he is given a final, dangerous mission:
Assassinate Grand Duke Bayshark—the only ultra-dominant alpha in the empire, cousin to the Emperor, and the feared monster of the North.
Disguised as a bride, Gio attempts to poison him on their wedding night—
But instead, he is caught… and offered a new proposal:
“The Emperor sent you to marry me. Don’t you think it’s your duty as a loyal subject to make it look like a happy marriage? Just become my bride, assassin.”
A command to pose as the fake Grand Duchess, fooling the Emperor’s eyes.
Pretending to be a loving newlywed, performing with poise in high society—
It’s unlike any mission he’s taken before.
But that’s fine.
Gio has always completed every assignment perfectly.

113742.synopsis:
My boss talks nonsense every day just to chat with me for two more sentences.
1. From the top’s first-person perspective
2. Short and sweet
3. This story is purely fictional. If there are any similarities… oh wow, that’s so sweet
associated_names: 我的老板每天都在说废话

118606.synopsis:
Just before my unjust execution, in the most desperate moment of my life, I made a wish.
I don’t want to die like this.
If I’m given another chance…
I want to live proudly as myself.
I thought I had died.
But then—
“Wait… why am I a Constellation?!”
[Based on the memories of your soul, all your past achievements have been converted into divine stature. These are feats no human could possibly accomplish.] 
Given a new life, I made a vow:
This time, whether people praise me or treat me like a criminal, I won’t be swayed.
But… the people around me? They’re all lunatics in their own ways.
“I’m an S-Class Awakened, so I thought maybe I could earn a bit more of your attention…”
—My contractor worships me like a god.
[Excuse me? That’s a pretty decent contractor you’ve got there.] 
—Another Constellation keeps reaching out, burning with an unnecessary sense of rivalry.
【If you hate me that much, it hurts. And when you leave your gifts like that, it breaks my heart.】
—My manager, who follows me everywhere with an angelic face and clingy attitude.
“I needed a new Constellation to contract with, and you’re the perfect fit.”
—Even an arrogant human who thinks he’s the best in the world has his eyes on me.
Hey… can you all stop obsessing over me already?
《A Strange Yet Romantic Return Report》

119118.synopsis:
“Kiddo! Mom and Dad are leaving. Don’t miss us!”
The young man stood in his home, staring at the letter in his hand, completely frozen.
“Kiddo! We’re not that heartless—we left you a mecha repair shop. Work hard~”
Young Man: ……
“You call that dump a repair shop??”
Just then, a system awakened. The rundown warehouse in front of him transformed into the strongest mecha repair shop on the planet.
“Boss… isn’t your repair fee a bit much? It’s just a Ground-Class Mecha and you’re charging 1.5 million? Rip-off!”
The young girl looked at her beloved mecha and the sky-high repair cost, torn with indecision.
Young Shop Owner: “I don’t just repair—I can awaken your mecha’s innate abilities!”
“Could you really bear to let your mecha become a pile of scrap?”
“Are you insane?! I just came in for a tune-up and you want to charge me ten billion?!”
“This tune-up could launch you to the top of the interstellar ranks. Are you sure you don’t want to reconsider? Of course, you can also go for customization—innate skills, rare armor, truth-grade materials—I’ve got everything you need. Satisfaction guaranteed!”
…
When alien invaders attack and the tide of star beasts surges, truth-grade mechas rise across the Blue Star Alliance.
The young man charges ahead, sweeping through enemies like a storm.
Everyone: “You were just supposed to run a repair shop, and now you’ve triggered a mecha war?!”
associated_names: 让你开维修店，你掀起机战风暴？

120654.synopsis:
Li Yi, who traveled to a parallel world, obtained the Apocalypse Supreme System, but… the system arrived ten years early.
So—
Even though I plant bombs in public areas, I’m still a good citizen.
Even though I sell hypersonic missiles, I still love peace—after all, it’s not like I’m the one firing them!
Even though I run a military academy overseas, you can’t deny I’ve boosted the average education level.
Of course, if the cadets take part in coups or whatever… how’s that the fault of a school owner like me?
What? You’re saying I’m monopolizing the medical market with overpriced gene serums?
No no no, blame your country for not negotiating a national health insurance deal with me. Just look at Hua Nation—the patients there are practically building me a monument for eternal life!
And how many times do I have to say it? That’s a security company, not a war contractor. We’re committed to global peace and stability.
What? You’re saying I’m lawless?
Now that, I won’t deny. After all, I’m the one who sets the laws, I’m the one who governs the skies—without me, there really would be no law and no order!
As for your claim that I’m teaming up with the elites to control humanity’s destiny?
Let me set the record straight:
That… is absolutely true!

128078.synopsis:
For twenty years, Zhou Yanzhi and I were a couple bound by resentment.
During our worst fight, he gripped my throat and demanded to know why Jiang Lingyi had been the one chosen for the political marriage, why I wasn’t the one who had died.
I laughed and told him it was because he was incompetent, powerless to protect Jiang Lingyi. After so many years as husband and wife, we knew each other’s deepest wounds and exactly how to tear them open.
But on the day of the rebellion, Zhou Yanzhi shielded me with everything he had. He took several arrows to the chest and died in my arms.
As he lay dying, he wiped away my tears, a look of release on his face. “Don’t cry,” he whispered. “All these years… I’ve been so tired.”
“If there is a next life, let’s set each other free. I want to go find her…”
When I opened my eyes again, I was back on the day the Southern Kingdom requested a political marriage.
I no longer forced the issue. I took the initiative and requested to be the one sent for the marriage.
This time, I decided to grant Zhou Yanzhi his wish.

130638.synopsis:
The girl who summons evil spirits, Theresia.
She got engaged to a monster, sacrificing her blood to stop the evil spirits, but the one she trusted disappeared right before her wedding.
The end of ten years together was a sudden breakup, how could this be?
***
“I missed you, Thea.”
After six years, he returned, just as she remembered him.
Cold, arrogant, self-centered, and utterly hopeless.
She had hoped he might’ve changed, but nothing about him had.
She was tired.
“By tomorrow, the Duke’s estate will receive our official breakup notice. Don’t ever show up in front of me again.”
She thought that was the end…
But from that day on, something strange began happening to Terzia’s body.
“My, my body is strange. My face is too hot… Haa, sob.”
Terzia whimpered as she felt him roughly digging into her lips. You bastard, what on earth have you done to my body?

132174.synopsis:
Zhu Qing’s life was marked by hardship and poverty. She worked tirelessly from dawn to dusk, juggling three jobs at once. Despite her struggles, she graduated with top honors from the police academy and became a policewoman.
In the original storyline, she was destined to meet the male lead, who would rescue and heal her… only for her to sacrifice herself to protect him during duty, ending her short life tragically.
According to the plot, a child speeding by in a go-kart would prompt the male lead to pull her close, accidentally revealing his identity and provoking a hidden criminal’s mu*derous intent.
Zhu Qing regained her memories of the book at the very moment she was about to die in the line of duty.
As the go-kart skidded toward her, in a split-second decision, she kicked the male lead away—
Only for a three-year-old little master with a head of curly hair to come to a slow stop, studying her with a cold expression and a c*cky, childish voice.
“You look like my niece.”
…
The case was solved, sending shockwaves through Hong Kong.
Zhu Qing turned out to be the niece of a young heir to a billion-dollar fortune!
At first, the icy-faced little uncle scoffed, “Pfft, you can actually solve cases?”
But later—
Amidst cases like the Rainy Night Dismemberment, the Parasitic Heiress, and the Locked-Room Death…
The little one gazed at her with starry eyes: “Can I work with you from now on?”
Zhu Qing: “No. Way.”
The kid clenched his fists: “C’mon, Madam, I’m super capable!”
Zhu Qing: “Pfft. As if.”
associated_names: The Little Police Flower of Hong Kong Inherits a Young Tycoon
香江小警花繼承豪門幼崽後
香江小警花继承豪门幼崽后

135502.synopsis:
“Please! Just make another game—we’ll do anything you ask!”
Lu Fan, a washed-up film director, awakens a movie production system, only to find himself transmigrated to a parallel world—a cultural wasteland—where he becomes a game developer in Daxia.
While tech giants in Silicon Valley are still busy making Sudoku and match-three games, Lu Fan takes his crappy filmmaking mindset and turns Earth’s movies into heavily modified games, dishing out top-tier torment to players—
—Survive in Shawshank Prison while underground boxing with twin sisters;
—Race against the Joker in Gotham City behind the wheel of a Batmobile;
—Ride a T-Rex and fight a Mosasaurus on the shores of Jurassic World;
—Get stuck choosing whether or not to eat the brain sashimi Hannibal enthusiastically offers…
“Anything, you say? Do you even know what you’re signing up for? Have you done your daily self-reflection today?”
Seeing the newly unlocked National Fate Showdown mission, Lu Fan showed a devilish grin—
The Sakura Federation wants to develop shipbuilding? I’ll hit back with Ghost Ship!
Zhidong is playing around with nuclear testing? Time to unleash Godzilla!
Let’s put The Wolf of Wall Street out there and make the White Eagle do some deep financial soul-searching!
…
At the Game of the Year Awards, faced with accusations from global media about cultural invasion, Lu Fan pulled out his AAA masterpiece Let the Bullets Fly, expressionless.
“If I told you I was just a guy making crappy films, would you believe me…?”
associated_names: 说好摆烂拍电影，年度游戏什么鬼

137038.synopsis:
Yu Xiaowen is a broke, defective Omega, with a damaged gland that can’t be marked, so he can’t find a partner. A lonely man with no parents, and now he’s terminally ill.
Self-statement: Looking back on my life, there’s nothing I’m really attached to. Back in high school, I liked an S-class Alpha so much it almost killed me, but he took the love letter I gave him and pinned it on the school bulletin board. Because he thought my actions, and the scent of my inferior kind, were both disgusting.
That man came from a powerful family, and there was a huge gap between us. After graduation, he became even more unreachable. But by a twist of fate, I somehow ended up with a deadly secret of his in my hands…
I’m almost dying. If it were anyone else, I’d let it go. But him…
I want to disgust him one more time.

139598.synopsis:
Simply for casually ranting about the novel’s boring plot and the tragic fate of a certain supporting character, Luo Yunhuan was instantly yanked into the story’s world by a cursed System.
Her mandatory mission: to conquer the book’s most unattainable character, the Grand Senior Sister, who cultivates the formidable Emotionless Dao!
This is a Hell-level challenge, especially since Luo Yunhuan has zero experience with romance!
Nevertheless, she had no choice but to brace herself, spending every day clinging to the Grand Senior Sister, relentlessly showering her with warmth and comfort.
Then one day, Luo Yunhuan found herself pinned against a wall, with no room to escape. The eyes of the famously aloof and self-possessed Grand Senior Sister were stained crimson.
“Yunhuan, I can’t sever the threads of emotion. I… I can no longer cultivate the Emotionless Dao.”
associated_names: 穿书！系统要我攻略禁欲师姐
穿書！系統要我攻略禁欲師姐

202318.synopsis:
After spending a full year on it, Ning Busan finally cleared the game Xenos Invasion, achieving the perfect “save the world” ending!
The moment he beat the game, Ning Busan found himself transmigrated ten thousand years into the future — the Xenos have returned, and the continent of Lantiya teeters on the edge of ruin!
The good news: he has seven maxed-out accounts!
The bad news: he racked up too much bad karma on them to dare use any!
All Ning Busan wants is to become a mage and find a way home.
Little does he know, the wheels of fate are already turning — he is destined to become the world’s savior once again…
associated_names: 你丫敢动我？我有七个满级号
